statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD use this to tailor their output.
actions: Tailor output based on the acceptedOutputModes list provided by the client

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.
actions: Ensure the number of returned messages does not exceed the historyLength value

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.
actions: Apply a lower limit on message history than the value specified by historyLength

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If false (default), the operation MUST wait until the task reaches a terminal (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED) or interrupted (INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED) state before returning.
statements.post_cond: task.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED | task.state = TASK_STATE_FAILED | task.state = TASK_STATE_CANCELED | task.state = TASK_STATE_REJECTED | task.state = TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED | task.state = TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
actions: Block the operation from returning until the task reaches a terminal or interrupted state

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The operation MUST wait until the task reaches a terminal state (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED) or an interrupted state (INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED) before returning.
statements.post_cond: task.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED | task.state = TASK_STATE_FAILED | task.state = TASK_STATE_CANCELED | task.state = TASK_STATE_REJECTED | task.state = TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED | task.state = TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
actions: Block the operation from returning until the task reaches a terminal or interrupted state

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The response MUST include the latest task state with all artifacts and status information.
statements.post_cond: response.task.state != null & response.task.artifacts != null & response.task.status != null
actions: Include latest task state in the response
Include all artifacts in the response
Include status information in the response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The operation MUST return immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress.
actions: Return response immediately after task creation without waiting for task completion

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: A StreamResponse MUST contain exactly one of the following: task, message, statusUpdate, artifactUpdate
actions: Include exactly one of: task, message, statusUpdate, artifactUpdate in each StreamResponse object

statements.subject: server
statements.description: 0: No history should be returned; the history field SHOULD be omitted
actions: Omit the history field from the response when historyLength is 0

statements.subject: extension
statements.description: Custom protocol bindings MUST specify how service parameters are transmitted in their binding specification.
actions: Document how service parameters are transmitted in the custom protocol binding specification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: As service parameter names MAY need to co-exist with other parameters defined by the underlying transport protocol or infrastructure, all service parameters defined by this specification will be prefixed with a2a-.
actions: Co-exist service parameter names with other parameters defined by the underlying transport protocol or infrastructure
